pages.text: An upgrade goes into one face and raises everything that face does. It is also what unlocks the settings at all: a bare face moves things, but cannot be given a redstone mode, a distribution mode or a filter rule.$(br2)$(o)none$(): 256 FE/t, 50 mB/t, 1 item every 20 ticks, no rules.

$(6)Basic$(): 1,024 FE/t, 200 mB/t, 4 items / 20t, 5 rules.$(br)$(6)Improved$(): 8,192 FE/t, 1,000 mB/t, 8 items / 10t, 7 rules.$(br)$(6)Advanced$(): 65,536 FE/t, 5,000 mB/t, 16 items / 5t, 9 rules.$(br)$(6)Ultimate$(): 524,288 FE/t, 25,000 mB/t, 32 items / 2t, 12 rules.$(br)$(6)Infinity$(): unlimited, 64 items every tick, 15 rules.
